gold_review.explanation: The reward judge_score (default reward='judge', judge_mode='no_reference') is an LLM ReferenceJudge verdict. Every gold rollout ended in TaskError because the judge call got 401, so judge_score, reference_judge and true_correct were all null (the true_correct verify.py would accept the raw number).
